cdbf.test.info.en: CrazyDramas shows each viewer one of two unlock sheets, decided by their viewer id: Weekly VIP first, or this series first for $0.99. People shown: the people shown that sheet, counted per day. People paid: the people who paid after seeing it, renewals and refunds left out. VIP, Series and Coins: their payments by what was bought. Half the viewers saw each sheet from Oct 2 to Oct 4, 2026 (11:35 AM Pacific); since then three quarters see VIP first.
cdbf.test.info.zh: CrazyDramas 按观众 ID 给每位观众展示两种解锁页之一：周 VIP 优先，或 $0.99 的本剧优先。展示人数：看到该解锁页的人数，按天计。付款人数：看到后付款的人数，不含续费和退款。VIP、剧集、金币：这些付款按购买内容计。2026 年 10 月 2 日至 4 日（太平洋时间上午 11:35）两种各占一半；此后四分之三的观众看到 VIP 优先。

cdbf.test.none.en: No paywall test numbers for these days. They start on Oct 2, 2026 and arrive with the next crazydramas release.
cdbf.test.none.zh: 这些日期没有付费墙测试数据。数据自 2026 年 10 月 2 日起，随 crazydramas 下一次发布到来。

cdbf.test.wholeSite.en: The paywall test is for all of CrazyDramas: the series, phone, source and country filters don't apply to it.
cdbf.test.wholeSite.zh: 付费墙测试涵盖整个 CrazyDramas：剧集、手机、来源和国家筛选不适用。

cdbf.mix.info.en: Every payment in the period by what it bought, refunds left out. New VIP: a first week at the intro price or a full plan. Series: one series unlocked (part 1 of a long series counts here). Renewals: VIP periods after the first.
cdbf.mix.info.zh: 该时段内每笔付款按购买内容分组，不含退款。新 VIP：首周优惠价或完整套餐。剧集：解锁一部剧（长剧的上半部分计入此处）。续费：首期之后的 VIP 周期。

cdbf.camp.info.en: Each TikTok campaign's spend in the period (TikTok's own days) against what its visitors did on CrazyDramas. Paid: payments by people who landed from that campaign, renewals and refunds left out. Cost per payment: spend divided by those payments. Robots are left out of the visitors.
cdbf.camp.info.zh: 每个 TikTok 广告系列在该时段的花费（按 TikTok 的日期）与其访客在 CrazyDramas 上的行为。已付款：从该系列进入的人的付款，不含续费和退款。每笔付款成本：花费除以这些付款。访客不含机器人。

cdbf.camp.none.en: No campaign had visitors or spend in this period.
cdbf.camp.none.zh: 该时段内没有广告系列有访客或花费。
